title: TopFGL: A Topology-Aware and Distribution-Agnostic Federated Learning Framework Tackling Topological Heterogeneity on Graph Data
motivation: Graph data silos due to GDPR privacy regulations block collaborative learning; existing FGL fails under topological heterogeneity
problem_framing: Topological heterogeneity across clients causes divergent GNN training directions, degrading model aggregation; prior works leak intermediate info or lack adaptability
key_insight: Train lightweight topology learners to capture explicit topological patterns; leverage learned topology for similarity-based server aggregation and client-side augmentation without sharing raw data
method_signature: Topology learner + CKA-based compatible aggregation + dual-model guided topology augmentation
evaluation_criteria: Accuracy (5.6% gain) and training time reduction (50%) across 11 datasets, 3 distributions, up to 100 clients
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Performance may diminish when graph structure is noisy or detrimental to representation learning
evidence_for_taste: directly extracting topological guidance from the topology-unaware models cannot guarantee accuracy
sharing embeddings can lead to label leakage
these approaches struggle to maintain effectiveness under varying topological distributions
the strong emphasis on topology also frames the applicability of our framework
thinking_moves: 把拓扑异质性问题拆分为全局聚合不兼容和本地邻居不足两个子问题
先用轻量级探测网络学习显式拓扑表征，再反推客户端间的拓扑相似度
通过对比主任务GNN和拓扑学习器的预测差异来定位拓扑不足节点
借鉴图对比学习的思路：用一致性边过滤(KNN+LCC)增强稀疏图连通性
